method.Data: HubSpot read-only pull, 8 Oct 2026. JTP = 8 'JTP' contact forms (Startups, Corporates, Governments, Universities, VCs, APAC, All profiles, Contact us). Content downloads = 66 CDW / RFI / resource forms. Period: submissions 1 Oct 2025 – 30 Sep 2026.
method.Unit: Unique contacts (a contact with several submissions is counted once, profile and outcome as stored on the contact).
method.Profile: JTP: 'Type of profile form'. Content: 'RFI Type of profile' (fallback: 'Type of profile form', then 'Ebook Type of Profile').
method.Persona: From job title, first match wins: Innovation / R&D / Digital (innovation, R&D, CDO, chief digital, digital transformation, venture, scouting…); C-level (chief, CEO, COO, CFO, CTO, CIO, CMO, CSO, president, managing director, general manager…); Founder; Government / policy; Other title; Empty. Common Japanese title terms included.
method.Company size: Employees (contact, then associated company); if empty, the employee / company size dropdowns. Revenue = mirror company or company annual revenue.
method.ICP (Buyer Persona 2024): ICP – Corporate: corporate profile + Innovation/R&D/Digital or C-level + 10,000+ employees (+ revenue ≥ $100M where known). ICP – Government: government profile. Secondary ICP – Startup founder: startup profile + founder or C-level title. Partial = profile fits but job title or size is missing. Not ICP = everything else.
method.Outcome: Lead Status (SFDC): Qualified / Converted / SQL = qualified; Disqualified; Qualification; New. Deal = at least one associated deal. Customer = 'Date entered Customer' is set. Lifecycle stage is not used: 95% of JTP contacts are 'Sales Qualified Lead'.
method.Not included: 1,733 submissions on the two 'All profiles - dependent fields' forms have no contact record in HubSpot (per the HubSpot pull).
method.GDPR: Raw contact data was processed only in a temporary workspace and deleted after the analysis. This file holds aggregated counts only; counts of 1–4 are shown as '<5' and rates based on them as '–'. No names, emails, company names or record IDs.
